crossRefs.note: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors, until he should pay all that was due to him.
Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared…
These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
I tell you, you will by no means get out of there, until you have paid the very last penny.”
Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not…
who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

parallels.note: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there, until you have paid the very last penny.”

translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there, until you have paid the last penny.
translations.bsb: Truly I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.
translations.kjv: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
translations.asv: Verily I say unto thee, thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou have paid the last farthing.
